Find the values of θ at which the curve x=13cos⁡θ,y=sin⁡θ,0≤θ<2π intersects the line 3x+y=0.

a
5π6,4π3
b
2π3,5π3
c
2π3,11π6
d
5π6,11π6

5π6,5π3
